items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-04
items.q: I used to play with Dude Foster. He'd come over there.

ctx.x: Who were some of those guys?
Well, I used to play with Punch Miller. He'd come over there. I used to play with Dude Foster. He'd come over there. Rene.
Now who is Dude Foster? Is that the trumpet player? Yeah. What, did he have a brother?
